trailhead.label: Campiolo, by the parking places at the start of path CAI 417, the board’s start

cautions: Parts of this walk are exposed; keep your dog close and on a short lead.
A mule track along steep slopes above the Glagnò gorge, with guard rails in places: keep your dog on a short lead.
A long steady climb of about 380 m.
Not advised in bad weather or the hottest summer hours.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
